exposure: timing of systemic chemotherapy for cancer in pregnancy (during pregnancy vs. deferred until after delivery)
outcome: maternal adverse outcomes due to delayed treatment
cohort: Women diagnosed with cancer during pregnancy and referred to a medical oncology department in an Irish cancer centre over 27 years.
finding: In a select cohort of patients who deferred chemotherapy until after delivery, there were no adverse maternal outcomes due to delayed treatment, with all mothers remaining disease-free after a median follow-up of 12 years.
